name: Raenelle Talisko
source:
A lazy and unambitious Reanimator who hates her job, Raenelle is always grumpy and constantly sleepy. The only things she wants and cares about in life are to sleep more, eat more
and earn more - without working more. She wields her snark as both a sword and a shield in response to everything, making her quite emotionally resilient - yet also come across as slightly apathetic.
